fusions.name: Jackhammer Bit
fusions.desc: Drives a hammering bit into the target, which deals 13 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Seismic Charge
fusions.desc: Detonates a charge sunk in the ground under you, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and leaves each [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Borehole Transit
fusions.desc: A boring head cuts a shaft under you and brings you up at a spot up to 6 tiles away. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Metalled Road
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
